author: 9to5Google
description:
Welcome to episode 99 of Pixelated, a podcast by 9to5Google. This week, Abner, Damien, and Will tackle the latest rumors surrounding Google's Pixel 11, which could arrive later this summer with new camera sensors, whatever Pixel Glow is, and a whole lot of downgrades. Then they turn to the long-awaited Fitbit Air and try to predict how the fitness tracker audience will react to a significantly cheaper Whoop competitor.

author: 9to5Google
description:
Fresh Tensor G6 leaks suggest Google’s Pixel 11 may not deliver the performance jump many Pixel fans were hoping for.

In this video, we break down the latest Tensor G6 leak, including the underwhelming GPU, more promising CPU changes, the move to a MediaTek modem, Titan M3 security updates, and what all of this could mean for Pixel 11 camera performance and everyday use.

The big question: is Google falling further behind flagship rivals, or is Tensor still good enough for real-world Pixel users?
